description: This file defines the Java class UserProfileItemImpl which implements the UserProfileItem interface. It encapsulates user profile settings related to data units and selection options within an ECU profile context.

classes.name: UserProfileItemImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing UserProfileItem, representing user profile configuration options such as units and selection states.

methods.name: UserProfileItemImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the profile item with units and selection booleans.

methods.name: isDashSelected
methods.description: Returns whether the dash view is selected.

methods.name: isGraphSelected
methods.description: Returns whether the graph view is selected.

methods.name: isLiveDataSelected
methods.description: Returns whether live data is selected.

methods.name: getUnits
methods.description: Returns the units associated with this profile item.
